items.summary: Full-stack developer building reservation and enterprise web platforms with modern JS frameworks and AEM.

Developed full-stack solutions for a large-scale AEM initiative unifying multiple company sites into one domain.
Adopted advanced AEM concepts like live copies, blueprints, and deployment pipelines.
Integrated AI tools and agents into daily workflows to boost development efficiency.

items.summary: Cross-functional intern building AEM components and backend integrations for a demo banking site.

Implemented backend logic via Sling Models and Servlet-based API connections.
Delivered consistently under Agile/Scrum practices on a fixed academic timeline.
